notable_absence.finding: 'Different information may be shown, depending on your access control role' is a direct statement that RBAC gates what this UI displays, but no role is named anywhere on the page - contrast with learn/security/roles.md's 56 named roles elsewhere in the corpus. No requiresServerRole relation minted since no role name is stated; recorded as a finding rather than invented.

cross_component_finding: The Completed Queries table's 'runtime exceeded a system-specified threshold (default 1 second)' is a hasDefaultValue-shaped fact (a configurable setting with a stated default) but the page never names the setting that controls the threshold, unlike query-settings.md elsewhere in the corpus which names request-level parameters like timeout/txtimeout explicitly with their own anchors. No relation minted for the same reason as the role gap above: the mechanism is real but unnamed on this page.
